details: Orange status' hidden from friends feature feels very misplaced and should be moved to the Red status. (Of course in my opinion) Currently having this feature on Orange creates an ever feeling that no one is online/no one to join on with tangent of users that are also on Red status.  Personally, I feel if a user wants to use the hidden feature then they would also like to not to be bothered by request making it a fitting feature under the Red status. Having basically a hidden status and a ignore status creates way to many ways of excluding yourself and friends and friends of friends from socializing in this game. At the very least, I advocate that the orange status' invisibility should not be active in a friends lobby that you are friends with, at the very least, should help alleviate that issue of no one to join on by a bit. If nothing is changed of it, I at the very least hope players would use it for specific situations instead as a constant status. On a side note, if you think "just request on them then" as a good answer, then allow me to remind you, that a lot of people are very uncomfortable with requesting, sometimes myself included.  I hope for a change though cause of current state of things, orange status feels very unhealthy for the game.
title: Orange Status' hidden feature should be swapped to the Red status
